Kit summary

Frost Shield BashBasic
Deals 200% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 20% chance to inflict [Freeze] for 1 turn. The chance is doubled if Giant Ice Shield has been activated.
Frigid ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.2
Recovers self HP by 20% of Max HP, with a 40% chance to inflict [Freeze] on all enemies for 1 turn. If the target is already under [Freeze] status, inflicts [Stun] for 1 turn instead. This [Stun] effect cannot be removed or blocked.
Frost Shield Lv.2Frigid Shield: Increases the restoration amount to 30% of Max HP, before which cleanses all debuffs from self.
Power of FrostPassive
After Giant Ice Shield is activated, there is a 36% chance to inflict [Freeze] on attackers who deal active DMG to Naseal or an ally granted [Ally Protection] by Naseal for 1 turn.
Giant Ice ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.1
Naseal activates Giant Ice Shield, increasing self Max HP Cap by 100%. This effect is reduced by 20% every turn. When Giant Ice Shield is in effect, Naseal is immune to all control effects and acts 1 more turn, then this skill is changed to Shield Support. Shield Support: Naseal targets 1 ally and grants [Ally Protection] to them if this ally does not have [Ally Protection], then 40% of the damage taken by them will be taken by Naseal instead. Naseal can protect up to 2 allies at the same time. Restores the target's HP by 26% of Max HP if the ally already has [Ally Protection] or the ally is Naseal himself.
Frost Shield Lv.1Naseal casts Giant Ice Shield immediately at the beginning of each wave. He is immune to this death when taking Fatal DMG. Meanwhile, restores his HP by 15% of Max HP. This effect only takes effect up to once per wave.
Shield SupportActiveExclusive Lv.3
Naseal activates Giant Ice Shield, increasing self Max HP Cap by 100%. This effect is reduced by 20% every turn. When Giant Ice Shield is in effect, Naseal is immune to all control effects and acts 1 more turn, then this skill is changed to Shield Support. Shield Support: Naseal targets 1 ally and grants [Ally Protection] to them if this ally does not have [Ally Protection], then 40% of the damage taken by them will be taken by Naseal instead. Naseal can protect up to 2 allies at the same time. Restores the target's HP by 28% of Max HP if the ally already has [Ally Protection] or the ally is Naseal himself.
